jobs.occupation: Science Hub Denmark Student Assistant
jobs.employer_name: COPENHAGEN CAPACITY, FONDEN TIL MARKEDSFØRING OG ERHVERVSFREMME
jobs.description:
The Science Hub Denmark initiative is expanding. Join us and help us tell the world why Denmark is a fantastic place to pursue a career in research!

We are looking for a promising Student Assistant with a passion for science to join our growing team that aims to brand Denmark internationally as an attractive career destination for elite researchers within Biosolutions, Biomedicine, Neuroscience, Sustainable Energy Tech, Quantum and AI.

We are still looking for a new setup for the team and are therefore open to profiles within all our focus areas.

Your tasks and responsibilities

• 
Assist the Science Hub team in running the project and developing and executing the various activities and events. Both online and in-person. This could imply some international travel.

• 
Conduct market research.

• 
 Candidate and university outreach.

• 
Provide administrative support to the team.

• 
 Work with our CRM system, HubSpot.

Your profileYou are currently studying a master’s degree and are excited about the opportunity to share with the world why Denmark is a great place to live and work. You are a motivated, creative and a structured team player. It would be good if you have some of the skills and competencies listed below but don’t worry if you don’t have them all. If you have the right mindset, everything is possible!

• 
A passion for science and an interest and firsthand knowledge of one of our research areas at Danish universities.

• 
Proficient in English both verbally and in writing.

• 
Outgoing with good communication and public speaking skills

• 
Good organisational and time management skills.

• 
Ability to work effectively within a team and independently.

Our offices are in the city center of Copenhagen, Denmark. You’ll work here part-time: 15-20 hours per week. We’ll agree on a work schedule that fits with your studies.Copenhagen Capacity Copenhagen Capacity is Greater Copenhagen’s organization for investment promotion and regionaleconomic development. We work to make the region even more attractive to foreign investment andmarket it internationally to attract companies, investors, and highly educated workers.

The goal is to create jobs, growth, and development in Greater Copenhagen. In addition to that, we are a close-knit, passionate organization with a multinational work environment where English is our shared office language. We value collaboration and connection, whether over lunch in the company canteen with colleagues across departments or at social events.

Science Hub Denmark Science Hub Denmark is an initiative dedicated to enhancing the international visibility of Danish research and career opportunities in Denmark. With funding from Villum Fonden, Novo Nordisk Fonden, and Lundbeck Fonden, the initiative will continue for three more years with the aim of significantly increasing the interest in Danish research worldwide, while also exploring innovative strategies for promoting career opportunities in Denmark. 

Emphasizing research excellence, societal impact, and quality of life, the initiative will utilize digital channels to engage researchers abroad and facilitate recruitment for research positions at Danish universities. The project focuses on key areas: Biosolutions, Biomedicine, Neuroscience, Sustainable Energy Tech, Quantum and AI; research strongholds where Denmark excels internationally. 

How to apply If you think you’re the right profile for this position and our team, please apply before the 8th of November 2026 by sending your CV and cover letter job@copcap.com with "Student Assistant – Science Hub" in the subject line.  Interviews are expected to be held in the week of 9-13 November.

If you have any questions regarding the role, please reach out to Head of Science Hub Denmark – Alexander Watts, by email: alw@copcap.com

jobs.occupation: Experienced High Voltage Specialist wanted for Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst
jobs.description:
Do you have at least three years of high voltage experience? At Bravida, you will install circuit breakers, disconnectors and switchboards and help build substations. Here, you will put your experience to use on critical electrical infrastructure projects that help secure Denmark’s power supply and support the green transition.

On behalf of Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst, Career | a JKS Company is recruiting experienced High Voltage Specialists for projects across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst has secured the framework agreement with Energinet, becoming a regular supplier of high voltage installation work across Zealand and Lolland-Falster. With this agreement and a strong order book, Bravida is expanding the department. You will join the team responsible for building, expanding, refurbishing and maintaining the infrastructure that the power grid of the future relies on.

Installation and construction of high voltage installationsYou will work at substations and other high voltage installations, putting your experience into practice. You will take responsibility for your own tasks and work alongside your team to deliver safe, high-quality work.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Installing and replacing circuit breakers, disconnectors and other substation components

• 
Carrying out cable work and working on earthing systems

• 
Working on switchboards, electrical installations and dismantling tasks

• 
Contributing to the construction, refurbishment and maintenance of high voltage installations

• 
Carrying out quality assurance and maintaining documentation

Over time, you will also share your knowledge by helping apprentices and new colleagues get to grips with their tasks.

You bring solid high voltage experience and take responsibilityYou are a qualified electrician or have an equivalent electrical qualification, with at least three years of hands-on experience in high voltage work. You are familiar with the tasks described and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, recognise what needs doing and understand that safety is integral to every task.

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Works independently and takes a structured approach

• 
Takes responsibility for the safety and quality of their work

• 
Is proactive, well-presented and works well with others

• 
Is physically fit and comfortable with hands-on work outdoors and at height

• 
Holds a category B driving licence and can provide a criminal record certificate

You must be able to communicate clearly in English and have a valid work permit for Denmark.

A company vehicle to take home and no on-call dutiesAt Bravida, you will join a team of skilled, dedicated technicians who take pride in their work.

You will work daytime hours with no on-call duties, normally five days a week. Start times depend on the project, and the working week can be discussed. The role is paid hourly, with pay based on qualifications, plus pension contributions and a flexible benefits allowance under the Danish “fritvalgsordning” scheme.

You will have a company vehicle equipped with the tools and equipment you need, which you can take home. Your exact location is therefore less important, provided you are willing to work at different sites across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

We look forward to hearing from youIf this sounds like the right role for you, please send us your CV. We review applications and invite suitable candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, and will close the vacancy once the right candidates have been found.

If you have any questions about the role that are not covered in this advertisement, please contact Recruitment Specialist Kristine Askjær on +45 3085 1302.

Please note that, for GDPR reasons, applications submitted directly by email will not be processed or receive a response.

jobs.occupation: Associate Professor in Public Health: Children and Young People
jobs.description:
At the National Institute of Public Health (NIPH), University of Southern Denmark (SDU), a position as Associate Professor in Public Health is hereby advertised with a focus on interdisciplinary, qualitative studies of children’s and young people’s health and well-being, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.About your future research environment  

The National Institute of Public Health (NIPH) is part of the University of Southern Denmark and is located in Copenhagen. As a national public health institute, we conduct research to improve public health in Denmark and Greenland. At the same time, we contribute internationally to the development of knowledge, theories and methods in the field of public health.

We offer an inspiring research environment in the heart of Copenhagen with skilled and dedicated colleagues from diverse research and educational backgrounds. Here, you will have the opportunity for academic exchange and further development of your own research areas, as well as participation in national and international networks. The position is anchored in the research group Health Promotion and Interventions, which conducts research on interventions addressing public health issues and works with methodological and theoretical challenges related to the design and evaluation of intervention and implementation studies. Our research concerns children, young people and families, as well as vulnerable and disadvantaged groups, and takes place in a range of settings, including daycare institutions, primary and lower secondary schools, upper secondary education, the healthcare system, municipal services, supermarkets and local communities.  You will actively participate in the daily activities of the research group and work closely with other researchers at NIPH.  

The duties include research, teaching and dissemination within the institute’s areas of expertise, including:  - Children’s and young people’s health, well-being and everyday life- The significance of digital media for children’s and young people’s lives and health- Health promotion and implementation research in daycare institutions, schools and upper secondary education- Interdisciplinary, practice-oriented research and development projects, including process evaluation- Advanced qualitative methods, including ethnography, interviews, focus groups and child-centred approaches- Teaching and supervision at bachelor’s and master’s level, including qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and implementation- Preparation of applications for external funding as well as project management and coordination- Contributions to the further development of the research environment, including method development and research group activities The following qualifications are highly valued:  You have established yourself as a qualified researcher within qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and intervention and implementation research, and you possess strong research and teaching qualifications at a high level. You have a relevant publication profile and extensive experience in disseminating research to researchers, practitioners, and other target groups. You have broad collaborative networks and experience in research collaboration with practitioners. As a person, you are dedicated and possess strong communication skills. You are able to build trusting relationships with students, colleagues, and external partners alike. As a teacher, you communicate up-to-date, relevant knowledge in an engaging, clear and understandable way, and as a supervisor you are skilled, inspiring, and supportive.  Qualifications  - A PhD degree in Public Health, Education, Sociology, Anthropology or a related field- Experience with intervention and implementation research- Documented experience in research on children’s and young people’s health- A strong profile within qualitative research- Experience in collaborating with practitioners, exchanging knowledge and disseminating research- Experience in national and international research collaboration- Documented teaching experience at university level and experience supervising students (e.g. bachelor’s or master's students)- Proficiency in Danish and English at a high level, both orally and in writing- Documented experience with scientific publications within relevant research areas 

Further information regarding the position can be obtained from:  Research Leader Susan Andersen,  mailto:suan@sdu.dk

Terms and conditions of employment  Appointment as an Associate Professor is for a fixed term of three years, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for associate professor as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation processShortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material. Interviews and tests may form part of the overall assessment carried out by the appointment committee.  Based on information from the entire recruitment process, the Head of Institute will decide which applicant is offered the position. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

• 
Motivated application

• 
Curriculum vitae

• 
Master’s degree and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original + verified English translation)

• 
Teaching portfolio

• 
Research plan, including an account of your own research and preferably a vision for future research 

• 
A complete list of publications

• 
Up to six of the most relevant publications. Please attach one PDF file per publication. In cases of co-authorship, a co-author declaration must be submitted as part of the PDF file.

• 
Reference letters/references may also be included

• 
A statement of other qualifications relevant to the position.

We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow merging and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘CV’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

If you experience technical problems, please contact mailto:hcm-support@sdu.dkApplication deadline 18 November 2026 at 23.59 (CET) 

We recommend that as an international applicant, you take the time to visit Work in Denmark where you will find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark, as well as the International Staff Office at SDU.  The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.  

About SDU  The University of Southern Denmark was founded to create value for and together with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talented individuals. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities, which can only be achieved with the right people.  The university’s researchers, teachers, students, managers, and technical-administrative staff constitute the foundation of our success.

Begge stillinger kræver almindeligt kørekort (Kategori B), samt at du behersker tyrkisk og engelsk.

Som vores nye koordinator bliver du omdrejningspunktet for den daglige drift. Du får ansvaret for at planlægge arbejdet for vores chauffører, men du er også en aktiv del af flåden og træder selv til bag rattet.

Planlægning og koordinering: Daglig ruteplanlægning og opgavestyring for selskabets ansatte chauffører.

Kvalitetssikring i marken: Køre periodisk med chaufførerne for at evaluere, vejlede og sikre vores høje kvalitetsstandarder.

• 
Aktiv kørsel: Selvom du har administrative opgaver, fungerer du også som aktiv chauffør (Kørekort B) i det daglige og i travle perioder.

Administrative opgaver: Håndtering af ad-hoc administrative opgaver relateret til driften.

Sparring og support: Fungere som primær kontaktperson, guide og motivator for chaufførteamet.

• 
Sprogkundskaber: Du skal kunne kommunikere flydende på tyrkisk og engelsk i både skrift og tale af hensyn til vores interne koordinering og samarbejdspartnere.

Erfaring med logistik, koordinering eller teamledelse (erfaring fra transportbranchen er en stor fordel).

Struktureret, løsningsorienteret og i stand til at bevare overblikket i pressede situationer.

Gyldigt kørekort (B) og erfaring som aktiv, rutineret bilist.

PROFIL 2: Chauffør (Kørekort B)

Vi søger en stabil og serviceminded chauffør, der vil være virksomhedens ansigt udadtil over for vores kunder. Du bliver en vigtig del af vores daglige leveringsteam.

Dine primære opgaver:

Transport og levering: Sikker og effektiv afvikling af de planlagte ruter i selskabets biler (Kategori B).

Kundeservice: Sikre at varer/ydelser leveres til tiden og altid med et højt serviceniveau og et smil.

Kvalitetsbevidst arbejde: Sørge for at køretøjet holdes pænt, og at gældende retningslinjer for transporten overholdes.

Samarbejde: Tæt dialog med koordinatoren og resten af teamet for at optimere hverdagen.

Vores forventninger til dig:

• 
Sprogkundskaber: Du kan tale og forstå enten tyrkisk eller engelsk på et fornuftigt niveau (og gerne begge dele).

• 
Gyldigt kørekort (B) og solid erfaring med kørsel i varebil eller lignende.

• 
Mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsfuld omkring dine arbejdstider og opgaver.

• 
Præsentabel, høflig og serviceminded over for kunder og kollegaer.

Hvad tilbyder ASIYE GROUP ApS?

• 
En stabil arbejdsplads med gode, engagerede kollegaer.

• 
Gode og professionelle rammer for udførelsen af dit arbejde.

• 
Mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling (særligt i koordinatorrollen).

Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Customer service: Ensuring that goods/services are delivered on time and always with a high service level and a smile.

Language skills: You can speak and understand either Turkish or English at a reasonable level (and preferably both).

Valid driver's license (B) and solid experience driving vans or similar vehicles.

Punctual, flexible, and responsible regarding your working hours and tasks.

Presentable, polite, and service-minded towards customers and colleagues.

What does ASIYE GROUP ApS offer?

• 
A stable workplace with good, dedicated colleagues.

• 
A professional environment for executing your daily tasks.

• 
Opportunities for personal and professional growth (especially in the coordinator role).

Salary based on qualifications.

Application and contact

Are you our new coordinator or driver? Send your application and CV as soon as possible to zekeriya-eker@hotmail.com. Please mark your application with either "Application: Coordinator" or "Application: Driver".

We conduct interviews ongoingly and fill the positions as soon as the right candidates are found.

If you have any questions regarding the positions, feel free to contact us via the above email, and we will get back to you.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor in Materials for Power Electronics / Printed Electronics
jobs.description:
The cross-border region Denmark-Germany is a powerhouse in industrial electronics. The Centre for Industrial Electronics (CIE) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) was established by a strong partnership between industry, academia and regional authorities. CIE is located at the campus of SDU Sønderborg and surrounded by a vibrant industrial environment. CIE is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Job description 

We are seeking an innovative and visionary Assistant Professor to join the Centre for Industrial Electronics in Sønderborg. The Centre currently has 40 staff, including full and associate professors, assistant professors, postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, and support staff. Funding has been secured to support to establish new research and test laboratories in key areas of industrial electronics. Our ambition is to deliver excellence in research, innovation, and education.

It is our vision that the Centre for Industrial Electronics at SDU will excel in areas of key relevance for companies in the region of Southern Denmark and beyond. 

Candidates are thus required to have a proven research records at least one of the following fields:

• 
General power electronics and its reliability

• 
Multimaterial additive manufacturing

• 
Printed electronics

• 
Polymer composites and nanocomposites for energy applications

• 
Surface and interface engineering

• 
Dielectric materials and capacitor technology

• 
Materials for power electronics

• 
Energy-device manufacturing

• 
Sustainable and circular electronics

 

Qualifications

The candidates must have a PhD in Electrical Engineering/Materials science/Mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline. 

We also expect:

• 
An outstanding research and publication track record 

• 
Experience with industrial collaboration

• 
Research experience in multi-material additive manufacturing of functional polymer composites

• 
Experience developing polymer nanocomposite dielectrics and thin-film capacitors

• 
Knowledge of nanoparticle surface modification, dispersion, and interface engineering

• 
Hands-on experience in materials processing, device fabrication, and electrical characterization

• 
Ability to investigate relationships between material structure, manufacturing conditions, and electrical performance

• 
Peer-reviewed publications in functional materials, additive manufacturing, or energy-device research

• 
Experience collaborating across materials science and electrical engineering.

Further desirable qualifications:

• 
Experience with bio-based, self-healing, or temperature-resistant capacitor materials

• 
Knowledge of scalable thin-film fabrication, including layer-by-layer deposition or coating.

• 
Experience translating research into industrial applications, particularly embedded heating, sensing, or battery-conditioning systems.

• 
Experience preparing research proposals, securing research resources, and training students.

 

Contact and further information

For information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical engineering, which encompasses SDU Electrical Engineering please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime.

For specific information on section and centre, please visit www.sdu.dk/ee and www.sdu.dk/cie. 

You are also welcome to contact the Head of the CIE, Professor Thomas Ebel (ebel@sdu.dk,  +45 93 50 72 05) for further information. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

A panel will assess the qualification of the candidate for the described post based on the submitted material. 

The application should include:

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Motivated application. 

• 
Ideas for research and development activities.

• 
Account of significant contributions to innovation in Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering Electronics.

• 
Complete list of publications.

• 
Publications most relevant to the position. 

• 
Summary and documentation of teaching experience, including account of experience in training students and outreach. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio. 

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

• 
References/reference letters may also be included.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the position is open from start of 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse workers for Black Friday
jobs.description:
Do you envision yourself as part of the daily operations in a large warehouse, and do you thrive working independently and in a structured and high paced manner? Then you might be the one we're looking for. On behalf of DSV, Randstad is seeking warehouse workers for the upcoming Black Friday high season, where the primary tasks consist of picking, packing and scanning various products. 

As a warehouse worker at DSV, you will have a great deal of responsibility for your own tasks and for ensuring that your work is of good quality. You are able to work independently and are encouraged to take initiative, as you become a part of a fast-paced working environment. It is also important that you bring a positive energy to the team and that you want to work in close cooperation with your colleagues.

Working tasks includes:

• Handling labels

• Driving various stablers, runners, stackers etc.

• Picking and packing

• Utilizing a scanner

• Receiving goods

• Driving and replenishment of pallets, orders, packages etc.

The job can be physically requiring at times as the picking is manual, and the tempo is high.

We expect that you:

• Have experience with similar positions in previous jobs - especially driving stablers

• Are highly motivated to contribute

• Respect the operations and procedures

• You can communicate in English

• You can work independently and in a structured manner

• You are detail-oriented

• It is an advantage if you have experience using handheld scanners and picking by autostore 

Important information about the position:

• This recruitment is specifically for our Black Friday peak season. You must be available for overtime, particularly on  Sundays. During the busiest period (one week before Black Friday, Black Friday week, and one week after Black Friday), candidates are expected to be available to work on Saturdays as well as Sundays. 

• Due to the busy Black Friday period, you must not have any planned holidays or vacation during the contract period. Any time off must be approved prior to starting. Vacation requests submitted after hire will not be approved. 

• Temporary position running from week 45 (startup November 2nd–4th) until just before Christmas. 

• Your onboarding meeting will take place on your first day of work. For morning shifts, onboarding is at 08:00. For evening shifts, onboarding will take place at 14:00. Onboarding is mandatory.

• Salary: 156.50 DKK/hour for Reach Truck Operators and 143.40 DKK/hour for all other profiles. 

• Safety shoes are required.

Open positions, shifts and starts dates:

• Morning shift (06:00 - 14:00): Looking for 6 candidates (2 AutoStore pick/pack, 1 experienced reach truck operator, 1 gift wrapping, 2 manual pack/sort). Start date: 3–4 candidates on Monday 02/11 or Tuesday 03/11. 

• Evening shift (14:00 - 22:00): Looking for 9 candidates (4 AutoStore pick/pack, 1 experienced reach truck operator, 1 gift wrapping, 3 manual pack/sort). Start date: 4–5 candidates on Monday 02/11 or Tuesday 03/11. 

• E-commerce department - Day shifts: Looking for 5 candidates (Foret 06:00-14:00: 1 pick/pack; Smartbox 08:00-16:00: 1 pick/pack; Babysam 09:00-17:00: 1 low-level picker & 1 manual pick/pack). Start date: All 5 candidates start on Wednesday 04/11. 

Application and contact:

If you want to know more about the position please contact consultant Liv Nielsen on email liv.nielsen@randstad.dk. All inquiries will be handled confidentially.

About Randstad

Randstad is the world’s largest talent company and a partner of choice to clients. As a Partner for Talent, we are committed to providing equitable opportunities to people from all backgrounds and helping them remain relevant in the rapidly changing world of work.

We have a deep understanding of the labour market and help our clients to create the high-quality, diverse and agile workforces they need to succeed. We support people to realise their true potential throughout their entire working life. This is what we do and what motivates us every day.

Randstad DK is part of the international Randstad Group. Every day, we help more than 600,000 people around the world find jobs. We specialise in finding, attracting, and retaining skilled talent to power businesses at speed and at scale. Randstad DK is a leader in this field, with offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus, Aalborg, and Kolding.
